Reason: Although the report generator describes normal mediastinal contours, visual inspection of Figure 1a reveals a widened superior mediastinum and bilateral subpulmonary lucencies consistent with pneumothoraces; in the context of blunt trauma, mediastinal widening is the classic radiographic sign suggestive of aortic injury. *(guided by t000002)*
